name: Tidepool
author: jgarza
description: A calm clock for the bar that grows into an agenda, a clock (world clocks, alarms, stopwatch, timers), media and weather. Bar-resident, theme-colored successor to the Nookisle island. Calendars: ICS files, calendar folders, iCal links (Google secret address) and CalDAV.

barWidget.description: Clock with next-event chip, hover peek and an agenda/timers/media/weather panel.

schema.label: Date / time
schema.description: The base of the widget.

schema.label: Next event
schema.description: Show a chip for the next calendar event after the divider.

schema.label: Timer
schema.description: Show the soonest running timer after the divider.

schema.label: Media
schema.description: Show what is playing after the divider.

schema.label: Weather
schema.description: Show the temperature after the divider (needs a city).

schema.label: Play / pause status
schema.description: A play or pause icon before the title; the media extra then stays while paused.

schema.label: Mini visualizer
schema.description: A few live spectrum bars next to the title while it plays (runs cava).

schema.label: Visualizer style
schema.description: How the spectrum is drawn, in the Media tab and on the bar. None turns it off.

options.label: Mirror
options.description: Bars growing up and down from the middle.

options.label: Dots
options.description: A grid of small dots that grow and shrink with the sound.

options.label: Fire
options.description: Digital fire: flickering square cells in the accent and its neighbouring colors.

options.label: None
options.description: Visualizer off: nothing is drawn and cava does not run.

schema.label: Available visualizers
schema.description: Comma-separated styles you can pick from: bars, mirror, dots, wave, line, fire. Dots and fire are drawn by a shader on the GPU; they start off so a fresh setup looks the same as before. None is always available.

schema.label: Extras shown at once
schema.description: 0 hides extras (and the divider). Fewer than you have switched on swap in turn, with dots for the rest.

schema.label: Extras style
schema.description: How each extra is drawn on the bar.

options.label: Border
options.description: Each extra in an outlined box.

options.label: Button
options.description: Each extra on a filled, button-like box.

schema.label: Time format
schema.description: Qt date format, e.g. HH:mm or h:mm AP.

schema.label: Date format
schema.description: Used by the date and the hover peek.

schema.label: Hover peek
schema.description: Show the next three events when hovering.

schema.label: Day-progress line
schema.description: A thin line under the widget that fills as the day passes.

schema.label: Swap every (s)
schema.description: Seconds per page when extras swap.

schema.label: Notify before events (min)
schema.description: Desktop notification this many minutes before an event. 0 turns it off.

schema.label: 'Soon' threshold (min)
schema.description: Events this close are highlighted in the accent color.

schema.label: Chip title length
schema.description: Longer event titles are shortened.

schema.label: Chip horizon (h)
schema.description: Only show the next-event chip when it starts within this many hours.

schema.label: Week starts on
schema.description: For the month grid.

schema.label: Weather city
schema.description: Looked up with Open-Meteo. Leave empty to hide weather.

schema.label: Units
schema.description: Weather units.

schema.label: World clocks
schema.description: Comma-separated time zones, e.g. Asia/Tokyo, Europe/London.

schema.label: Timer presets (min)
schema.description: Comma-separated minutes, e.g. 5,15,25,45.
